description: Consumi Energia Elettrica Pubblica Illuminazione 03/2018 - 03/2019 is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Puglia. Consumo di energia elettrica della pubblica illuminazione relativo al periodo 03/2018-03/2019 calcolato in KWh rilasciato in CSV. Coverage: Regione Puglia. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Puglia. Its tags are consumi-elettrici, consumi-pubblica, energia-elettrica. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
